searchText: IIUC for stateless, the idea is to have the clients provide the missing state (and proofs thereof) - is there any discussion anywhere of how this might actually work for clients (and how they will obtain this data)? <@!542045934360461313> , yes, there are discussions on stateless ethereum calls, stateless ethereum blog posts, the ethresear.ch forum, and in this discord server. For example, the neighboring channel <#688086042959806497> discusses a network for obtaining data. This channel seems focused on the witness structure, experiments, and the specification.
